---
title: "Advanced Adversarial Search"
subtitle: "A game-playing agent under an adversary"
---

An intelligent agent that plays a deterministic variant of Parchís using advanced adversarial search techniques, built in C++.

[View source on GitHub](https://github.com/laurasalop03/advanced-adversarial-search){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

## What it covers

- **Adversarial search**: choosing moves against an opponent who plays to win.
- **Search with pruning**: exploring the game tree efficiently.
- **Evaluation functions**: scoring positions to guide the search when full lookahead is impossible.

## Why it is relevant to quant work

Sequential decision making against an adversary, with search, pruning and hand designed evaluation, is close in spirit to reasoning about strategy under uncertainty.

## Tech

C++.
